sources.entry: IINA - The modern video player for macOS.

summary.one_liner: IINA is a modern macOS video and music player built on mpv.
summary.what_it_does: IINA is a media player for macOS (11.0+) that uses mpv for playback. The README lists support for subtitles, playlists, chapters, video thumbnails, and online subtitle searching with local subtitle matching. It includes a standalone Music Mode for audio files, picture-in-picture, Force Touch, and Touch Bar support. Users can customize the interface, keyboard, mouse, trackpad, and gesture controls, and use mpv configuration files and scripts. A command line tool and browser extensions are provided, and the project plugin system includes official and community plugins installable from an in-app store.
use_cases: play video files on a Mac
play local music files with a standalone audio mode
search and download subtitles for movies
extend the player with plugins or mpv scripts
how_to_run: Open iina.xcodeproj in the latest public version of Xcode
notable: Based on mpv for strong decoding support on macOS
Plugin system with official plugins and an in-app plugin store
Standalone Music Mode for audio files
Online and intelligent local subtitle matching
Fully customizable keyboard, mouse, trackpad, and gesture controls
caveats: Building requires the latest public version of Xcode; other versions may fail
Nightly builds may be buggy and unusable
